newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT -- Barrett Resources raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT -- Barrett Resources raised.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it upgraded Barrett Resources Corp to strong buy from hold.
-- cited stock's price decline over past three months and the company's strong prospects for future growth.
-- despite the upgrade, Salomon said it trimmed its 1997 earnings estimate to $0.70 a share from $1.10 a share and cut the 1998 estimate to $0.90 a share from $1.45 a share.
-- said trimmed the estimates to reflect reduced production forecasts.
-- said "we believe that are estimates are conservative."
-- Shares of Barrett, an oil and gas exploration and production company, rose 1/8 to 27-3/4.
